title.en: BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DESIGNATING PHILIPPINES (NCWP) AS ONE OF THE LEAD MONITORING NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANIZATIONS IMPLEMENTATION OF THE GLOBAL PLATFORM AND THE PHILIPPINE PLAN FOR GENDER-RESPONSIVE DEVELOPMENT IN THE NGO AND PRIV A TE SECTOR

text.en:
The NCWP shall be one of the lead NGO in mobilizing wider
participation among interested women's networks and organizations, consolidating and
promoting the issues of women in the country, working in partnership with the
government in the implementation of the Beijing Platform for Action and the Philippine
Plan for Gender-responsive Development nationwide, and subsequently in monitoring
their effective implementation at all levels and across sectors. The NCWP shall be
assisted by the PWU-DIW A as secretariat and technical arm in providing professional

services, training and continuing education for women and work in partnership with
con~erned women's networks and organizations, such as the Congressional Spouses
Foundation, Incorporated and the Philippine Centennial Commission-Women Sector.

In line with the framework and objectives set for achieving the foregoing
development agenda, there shall be a monitoring system established using gender-
sensitive indicators and guidelines to be defined in consultation with NCRFW and other
interested and concerned women's networks and organizations.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 7~ day of May
Nineteen Hundred and Ninety Six.
in the year of Our Lord,
By the President:
